title: Party identity policies diverge
detail: ensureParty trims documents; reconciliation cleanDoc rejects placeholders and short documents. Creation and ingestion can disagree.
action: Share normalized identity validation across JS and SQL; preserve person/company/agent/user distinctions.

title: POS event bypasses typed event registry
detail: pos.ticket_submitted is cast around HubEvent; internal event handler has no matching case.
action: Register schema and intended consumers together; test recognized events and deliberate no-op behavior.

title: Recipe resolution repeats across cost, issue and accrual
detail: POS and accruals repeat root/component lookup; pure stock math is already shared. Accruals cannot nest withOrgCore.
action: Share graph loading, precedence and UOM rules; retain distinct costing/reservation/issuance operations.

title: Tags share definitions but not mutation contracts
detail: Entity tags import a scheduling UI DTO; contact links use a separate validation/cache path.
action: Keep contact metadata/auto rules; share validation, mutation result and change publication through storage adapters.

title: Project assignee party creation is local
detail: ensureAgentParty and ensureSelfParty implement party creation outside party.service.
action: Add agent/user identity keys; do not force them into document/phone matching.

title: Mutations refresh isolated page dependencies
detail: List invalidates stock:items; detail invalidates stock:item-detail. Existing invalidation is not a cross-tab bridge.
action: Extend private org broadcasts with committed entity/version signals and canonical refetch; cover reconnect and organization switching.

title: CRM tag mutation ignores failed HTTP status
detail: Tag add/remove fetch then invalidate without checking status. Contact patch only handles success and 409 explicitly.
action: Surface errors and keep draft state; invalidate only on acknowledged success or explicit conflict recovery.

title: Stock edits lack comparable stale-write guards
detail: CRM uses expectedUpdatedAt; stock PATCH has no equivalent version and update predicates use ID/org only.
action: Add atomic compare-and-update and return authoritative version before widening autosave.

title: Flow save can clear a newer dirty draft
detail: Successful save clears current isDirty/draft without an in-flight revision guard. Source-level race; not runtime reproduced.
action: Serialize by entity, acknowledge exact revision, retain newer edits and failed drafts, add delayed-response regression test.

title: Notes duplicate autosave coordination
detail: Per-note timers, create/save coordination and retries sit beside existing keyed Pacer wrappers.
action: Preserve bounded retry and create-before-save behavior; share machinery without replacing domain state.

title: Inline editing contract is tied to names
detail: Nonempty trimmed-name semantics and no try/finally around rejecting onCommit limit reuse; current ProfileCard catches errors.
action: Add validation and pending/error/conflict state; align with concurrent DataTable editor before integrating.

title: Campaigns rebuild date-range controls
detail: Local query params, quick-range arithmetic and two date inputs bypass DateRangeControls.
action: Preserve inclusive day semantics; verify all-time end and coordinate toolbar with table owner.

title: Two generic SVG sparkline implementations
detail: Workforce copy normalizes min/max; charts copy scales from zero and smooths paths.
action: Extend before replacement; verify negative, flat, empty and spiky series.

title: CRM export rebuilds modal and segmented choice
detail: Fixed backdrop/dialog and CSV/XLSX toggle duplicate shared Dialog and SegmentedControl.
action: Keep explicit download; verify Escape, focus restore and selected format.

title: Flow editor rebuilds dialogs and fields
detail: ConditionModal duplicates dialog/field scaffolding; adjacent DeleteChapterModal duplicates destructive confirmation.
action: Retain form submit and delete confirmation; test errors, busy state and focus.

title: Builder rebuilds sheet and delete modal
detail: DeleteConfirmModal and RegistryAgentSheet independently implement dialog behavior.
action: Keep current async contracts and verify dismissal rules.

title: Destructive actions use native confirms
detail: Brains, socials settings, gateways, CRM and RBAC have native confirmation paths.
action: Keep confirmation; centralize pending/error presentation. Reserve POS and TeamTab for concurrent owners.

title: Radial progress has an independent state machine
detail: Badge uses Zag directly; ProgressBar owns normalization and ARIA. Upstream badge state already clamps processed, so no crash was reproduced.
target: Shared progress model with radial renderer
action: Preserve compact ring; share finite bounds and accessible status semantics.

title: Workforce bars and small empty states are local
detail: Generic bars can reuse ProgressBar; cost forecast bands and tiny empty states require extensions.
target: ProgressBar forecast variant + EmptyState inline density
action: Preserve actual/projected distinction and avoid oversized replacement in small panels.

title: Host connection dots bypass incomplete status model
detail: connected/connecting/disconnected mapping is local; shared plain-dot states do not represent these semantics.
action: Extend explicit states; do not equate disconnected with idle.

title: Graph scene controllers repeat lifecycle code
detail: Architecture already shares graph renderer/simulation, but pointer/wheel/lifecycle code repeats.
action: Preserve architecture drilldown, hover and teardown; do not merge specialized renderers blindly.

title: Flow persistence and invalidation live in route handlers
detail: Flow PUT/DELETE and flow-group routes own database mutations and cache invalidation; reconciliation is another writer. They already use withOrgCore, so this is not evidence of an org-scope bypass.
target: Flow repository/service over existing org-scoped transaction helper
action: Centralize version checks, graph serialization and invalidation; keep route auth and adapter-specific policy. workflow.service manages business document transitions and is not a substitute.
